$comment: Hand-authored search/discovery metadata, keyed by icon name. The name appears exactly once — here. `category` is always derived from the icons/ directory and must never be restated. An icon with no entry still generates (empty tags, mirror: false) and only warns; an entry with no matching SVG is an error. `mirror` marks glyphs that must be flipped horizontally under dir="rtl"; vertical direction never mirrors, and media transport controls (play, skip-*) deliberately do not mirror because playback direction is not reading direction. `priority` is authoring-only planning data (P0 essential enterprise UI → P3 optional) that drives docs/icon-catalog.md; it is deliberately NOT emitted into the published metadata, because it describes our backlog rather than the icon. Tags may be shared between icons ("warning" describes several); an alias may not, because an alias asserts that this icon IS also called that, and two owners would make the query ambiguous. One line per icon is deliberate and Biome formatting is disabled for this file (see biome.json) — at several hundred icons the compact form stays reviewable and produces one-line diffs.
